description: It’s pretty basic. Women and all persons must have agency over their lives and their bodies. No one should be “in” the doctor’s office with us, we make our own decisions with those who matter to us – and sometimes on our own. State Senator Janice Weiner strongly believes that Iowa must codify the protection of women's right into law.
